ns2:course.label: Principles of Arts Management
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the basic practices of theatre and arts management with emphasis on facilities management, arts marketing, and financial planning in the performing arts. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Junior, senior or graduate standing in theatre.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Junior, senior or graduate standing in theatre.
